data.bodyHtml: The man reeks of a pungent, musty odor; the capillaries in his eyes have burst, and his clothes are completely torn.
You have to understand me, we must do what is destined! We must free ourselves! Cast off the shackles of slavery! Tomorrow night, I will be waiting for you in the woods.
It doesn't matter who I am, what matters is who you are! Will you come with me?
Excellent! Glory to our path of liberation!
Fool! I wanted to grant you freedom, and you threw it away so easily!
Listen, listen to me. The end is near. You and I both know it, believe me...
